meta.name: ztmetro

files: ztmetro.c — shell: Start grid, tiles, status strip, action centre, motion
core/zrnmetrocore.h — zmc_* widget framework constants, fonts, tilt
core/zrnmetrocore.c — zmc_header / zmc_pivot_next / entries / fields, type sizes
settings/ztsettings.c — 20-colour accent set, accent picker, section headings
source.licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (SPDX headers in the C files)

reference.origin: core/zrnmetrocore.c:68 (zmc default 360x640 points); ztmetro.c:127 (all layout is logical points)

meta.origin_convention: Each value cites its C source as file:line, relative to meta.source.root. 'derived [E]' marks a value this repo computes or adapts for Android rather than reading directly from the C code. Numeric origins live in the sibling '_origins' map of the group that owns them; type ramp entries carry their own 'origin'.
notes: The C shell lays out in logical points at output scale; at the 720x1280 / 320 dpi reference 1 point = 1 dp, so the values below are dp (metrics) and sp (type) at fontScale 1.0.
The accent is user-selectable (20 named colours). 'cobalt' #0050EF is the compiled-in default and the value used for overlay-derived resources.
ztmetro draws square tiles: no rounded corners anywhere in the Start grid, quick actions or app list.
Widget type sizes are Cairo/Pango absolute sizes in points, not a CSS-like ramp; names here group them by role.
Motion values are the shell's own, measured from Lumia captures where the comments say so; Android interpolators are approximations (see README).

_origins.light1: derived [E] — the C code has no light accent: base mixed 25% toward white, for pressed/selected fills
_origins.light2: derived [E] — base mixed 50% toward white, for ripple/selected backgrounds
_origins.dark1: derived [E] — accent * 0.5, as in the lock-screen fade endpoint ztmetro.c:6030-6035
_origins.dark2: derived [E] — accent * 0.25, continuation of the same black-to-accent fade (ztmetro.c:6033-6035)
_origins.foreground_on_accent: ztmetro.c:3670-3673 (white glyph and label on an accent tile); ztmetro.c:6314-6320; ztmetro.c:6549-6551

_origins.black: ztmetro.c:6501-6502 (action centre painted black); ztmetro.c:7063-7068 (keyboard base)
_origins.text_primary: ztmetro.c:3672-3673; core/zrnmetrocore.c:508,547,573 (default text is pure white)
_origins.text_disabled: derived [E] — unavailable quick actions are white at 30% alpha (ztmetro.c:6321), composited on black; the C code has no opaque disabled grey

_origins.status_strip: ztmetro.c:128 with no background fill: the row is drawn white on the app/Start canvas (ztmetro.c:5415-5418)
_origins.list_letter_accent: ztmetro.c:4512,4519-4522 (letter/icon square in accent); ztmetro.c:159-161 comment
_origins.scrim_alpha: core/zrnmetrocore.c:4405 (menu dims the page with black at 0.72)

ramp.name: caption_caps
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — Pango natural line for 11.5 pt, rounded; the C code places the line at y=14 and the title at y=24
ramp.usage: the app's name over every page title, ALL CAPS; quick-action labels at 7.6 and CLEAR ALL at 10 are the same face but are not promoted

ramp.name: caption
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — 1.33x size, matches the 31 pt gap to a 25.5 title
ramp.usage: the grey second line under a hub entry; field captions sit at 13, one step up

ramp.name: body
ramp.usage: tile label, notification text, On/Off line, field caption

ramp.name: body_large
ramp.usage: value inside a text box; an option in an open picker

ramp.name: subtitle
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — 1.35x size, keeps the 34 pt switch/choice pitch
ramp.usage: switch title (21), dialog title (20), choice title (20), accent section heading (19)

ramp.name: list_title
ramp.line_height_origin: core/zrnmetrocore.c:550-552 — detail line drawn at y+31; row pitch 59
ramp.usage: hub entry title; one entry is 59 dp from the next

ramp.name: app_list_title
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — 1.27x size; the row itself is 55 dp (LIST_ROW_H)
ramp.usage: app name in the A-Z app list; the letter head is 27

ramp.name: page_title
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — 1.25x size; the C header fixes the content start at 108 dp (core/zrnmetrocore.c:491,532)
ramp.usage: the page title of the two-line zmc_header / zmc_pivot_next header, Semilight

ramp.name: display_large
ramp.line_height_origin: derived [E] — 1.2x size; the lock clock sits 268 pt above the bottom (ztmetro.c:5942)

origin.subtitle_size_sp: core/zrnmetrocore.c:509 (11.5 pt Semibold caps at y=14)
origin.gap: derived [E] — 24 - 14, the vertical offset between the caps line and the title line (core/zrnmetrocore.c:509-510)

_origins.tile_size_dp: derived [E] — ztmetro.c:3266-3272: gutter=round(360*0.02)=7, margin=14, units=6, unit=(360-28-35)/6=49.5 at the 360 dp reference; ztmetro.c:2996 (units=6)
_origins.start_columns: ztmetro.c:2996 (units = 6: three medium tiles across); ztmetro.c:141 (MAX_UNITS 8); ztmetro.c:3080 (columns 2..4 => units 4..8)
_origins.pivot_bar_height_dp: derived [E] — core/zrnmetrocore.c:531,537 (the header's tap band is 0..90, the two-line title block)
_origins.corner_radius_dp: ztmetro.c:3657-3697 (tiles are cairo_rectangle fills, no arc); quick actions likewise ztmetro.c:6318-6319
_origins.page_margin_dp: core/zrnmetrocore.h:37 (ZMC_MARGIN 16; comment: 20 px on a 450 px reference)
_origins.nav_bar_height_dp: ztmetro.c:130 (NAV_BAR_H 40; 0 when the phone has hardware keys, ztmetro.c:3032-3037)
_origins.round_button_dp: ztmetro.c:166 (ROUND 31; the Start arrow and app-list search button)
_origins.min_touch_target_dp: derived [E] — Android accessibility floor, not present in the C code; ztmetro's own round button is 31 dp and AC rows are 57 dp

motion._easing_note: ztmetro animates with a Log(10) ease-out and a back-ease-out overshoot (ztmetro.c:1096-1157); Android approximation derived [E]: DecelerateInterpolator for arrival, OvershootInterpolator(1.0) for tile return.
